rules.title: Wrong Authentication Service Usage
rules.content: Super admin routes MUST use SuperAdminAuthService, and tenant routes MUST use UnifiedTenantAuthService. Mixing these services causes security vulnerabilities and access control bypasses.

rules.title: Hardcoded Database Credentials
rules.content: Never hardcode database credentials in source code. Use environment variables and validate they exist at startup.

rules.title: Exposing Sensitive Data in API Responses
rules.content: Never return sensitive fields like passwords, API keys, or internal IDs in API responses. Always explicitly select safe fields.

rules.title: Direct Database Pool Usage
rules.content: Never use direct database pool imports outside of the DataService layer. All database queries must go through the platform DataService to ensure proper tenant isolation, connection pooling, and query optimization.

rules.title: Missing Table Catalog Validation
rules.content: Always validate table names against table catalogs (adminTables or tenantTables) before executing queries to prevent SQL injection and ensure table existence.

rules.title: N+1 Query Problem
rules.content: Avoid executing queries inside loops. Use batch queries with JOINs or IN clauses instead.

rules.title: Unhandled Promise Rejections
rules.content: All async operations must have proper error handling with try-catch blocks. Never let promises reject without handling.

rules.title: Upward Dependencies Violation
rules.content: Layers must respect the dependency hierarchy: modules → core → platform. Never import from upper layers (e.g., platform importing from core).

rules.title: Missing Authentication Middleware
rules.content: All protected routes must include proper authentication middleware (authenticateToken, extractTenantContext, requireTenantContext).

rules.title: Using 'any' Type
rules.content: Avoid using 'any' type. Use specific types or 'unknown' with type guards instead.

rules.title: Magic Numbers
rules.content: Replace magic numbers with named constants to improve code readability and maintainability.

rules.title: Missing Type Annotations
rules.content: Always provide explicit type annotations for function parameters and return types. Avoid implicit 'any' types.

rules.title: Route Path Inconsistency
rules.content: Tenant routes must start with /api/tenant/* and super admin routes with /api/super-admin/*. Never use ambiguous paths like /api/*.

rules.title: Missing Query Pagination
rules.content: Always implement pagination for list endpoints to prevent memory issues and slow response times.

rules.title: Missing JSDoc Comments
rules.content: Add JSDoc comments to all exported functions, classes, and interfaces to improve code maintainability.

rules.title: Generic Error Messages
rules.content: Provide specific, actionable error messages instead of generic ones. Help users understand what went wrong and how to fix it.
